decisions.reason: Linking portfolio tiles to the gallery is a separate clause and Requirement; changing the homepage hero image subject does not alter the tile destination.
The hero image subject does not change the existing destinations or behavior of the homepage page-link buttons.
Replacing the homepage hero image with a house photo does not change gallery hover-animation behavior.
The homepage hero image subject has no effect on package counts, square-footage ranges, or displayed pricing.

The candidate already records the separate stock-photo replacement clause from message 87; specifying a house as the hero image subject belongs to the atomic hero-presentation Requirement and does not necessarily change the candidate's image-source or selection rules.
Selecting a house photo for one homepage image is consistent with, but does not modify, the existing site-wide visual and image-focused presentation rule.
The hero image request does not change the source or target count of photographs used in the gallery.
The homepage hero image subject does not affect mobile pricing-table layout or scrolling behavior.
The hero image change does not alter gallery category tabs or the optional other-photography area.
The homepage hero image subject does not change the presentation or selection of individual service pricing.
The hero image change has no effect on the one-time pricing model or visibility of monthly and annual pricing tabs.
Changing the homepage hero image to a house photo does not modify interactive gallery scrolling behavior.
